title: What to Eat to Reach Your Natural Height
character: Full body character sheet of a friendly young teenage guy standing facing forward on an isolated solid white background. Clean semi-flat vector illustration style with soft subtle gradients and a crisp light rim light. Neat wavy brown hair, warm smiling approachable expression, wearing a vibrant coral-orange crewneck t-shirt that contrasts sharply against mint and teal, paired with dark navy straight-fit trousers and white-and-navy sneakers. Proportions are natural and stylized, vector line art with smooth shading.
voice: Bright, friendly, warm, educational, and briskly paced narrator.

scenes.vo: Have you ever wondered what to eat to grow taller?

figures.pose: Young guy in coral t-shirt looking up thoughtfully with hand on chin beside a vertical measurement ruler, curious cheerful smile

scenes.vo: Teens actually need about thirteen hundred milligrams of calcium daily.

figures.pose: Young guy smiling confidently and pointing towards the floating calcium badge beside him, standing straight
figures.label: Teen

icons.prompt: Flat stylized vector icon of a glass of rich dairy milk with a golden calcium badge, vibrant colors
icons.label: Calcium

scenes.vo: That is even more calcium than full-grown adults need.

figures.pose: Teen guy in coral tee smiling and holding up an apple, standing proud beside an adult
figures.label: Teen

figures.pose: Adult version of the character in a navy polo shirt shrugging friendly hands palms up
figures.label: Adult

scenes.vo: Vitamin D helps your body absorb that vital calcium.
scenes.photo: Clean cinematic close-up photo of fresh nutritious foods arranged on a bright marble surface: farm fresh brown eggs, whole milk bottle, sliced wild salmon, and sunny morning light streaming across.

scenes.vo: You get it from sunshine, milk, eggs, and fish.

figures.pose: Young guy smiling warmly with open hands presenting healthy food sources, sunny stance

icons.prompt: Flat saturated vector icon of a bright golden sun, clean graphic design
icons.label: Sunlight

icons.prompt: Flat saturated vector icon of a healthy cooked salmon fillet and boiled egg, bold clean colors
icons.label: Vitamin D

scenes.vo: Protein serves as the building block for growing tissue.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical render of human musculoskeletal anatomy showing healthy muscle fibers and bone structure glowing with warm biological energy, dark slate scientific studio backdrop.

scenes.vo: Without enough nutrition, kids may stay shorter than expected.

figures.pose: Young guy looking slightly concerned, slouched posture with shoulders dropped, standing next to a height marker
figures.label: Under-nourished

scenes.vo: Yet overeating will not push you past genetic limits.

figures.pose: Young guy attempting to stretch on tiptoes with a cheerful wry grin, hitting a dashed biological ceiling line
figures.label: Gene limit

scenes.vo: So how tall will your body naturally grow?

figures.pose: Young guy standing tall with great posture, looking directly at the viewer with an inviting smile and pointing forward
figures.label: You?

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.

figures.pose: Extremely happy young guy holding up a smartphone, smiling warmly at the camera with confident friendly posture
